name: Scylla's Surprise
source:
Scylla Kaligaris is the beloved host of Internet web series Unfathomable , and also a monster hunter on the side. She's about to shoot a new episode with her friends, but her friend Jaden is acting suspicious... Can Scylla solve the mystery and save her friends before it's too late?

[from [url=https://bobbiesquares.itch.io/scyllas-surprise]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Scylla Kaligaris是网络连续剧《深不可测》中深受喜爱的主持人，同时也是一名怪物猎人。她正准备和朋友们一起拍摄新剧集，但她的朋友贾登表现得很可疑……锡拉能否解开谜团并在为时已晚之前拯救她的朋友们？

[来自[url=https://bobbiesquares.itch.io/scyllas-surprise]itch.io[/url]]
